headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty hit 9-month highs extending a 4-week rally on record FII buying.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FPI inflows of Rs 1.22 lakh crore drove benchmark indices to 9-month highs during the week.
Global AI sell-offs and hawkish signals from the US Fed triggered brief mid-week market pullbacks.
Strong buying support in banking and auto stocks helped indices bounce back rapidly near 25,500 levels.
Uncertainty around crude oil supply and upcoming OPEC+ decisions weighed on global sentiment.
whatHappening: FPIs recorded their biggest-ever monthly investment of Rs 1.22 lakh crore in November 2026.
CCPA imposed a Rs 10-lakh fine on a seller for listing an 'Anti-Drone Gun' on IndiaMART.
India and the European Union are expected to sign a bilateral trade pact on December 16.
Four to five private Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) plan to go public by March 2027.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices extended their four-week rally as record foreign portfolio investments lifted Sensex and Nifty to nine-month highs.
Despite mid-week volatility caused by global AI tech sell-offs and Fed rate hike concerns, bank and auto stocks spearheaded a solid recovery.
Market participants are now closely tracking FPI flows, crude oil price movements, and global macroeconomic cues for direction.
